value.description: The value; null/undefined renders a dash. A number by default, or text when valueType is text.

valueType.description: How value is interpreted. number (default) formats it via fractionDigits; text renders it verbatim and ignores the numeric format options. Passing text while this is number throws.

size.description: Density tier — icon size, gap, degree tier.

weight.description: Number font weight (regular / semibold / bold); colour is independent.

hasDegree.description: Render the trailing cap-height degree glyph (°).

hasIcon.description: Show the leading marker-icon container (always on for setpoint/advice).

fractionDigits.description: Number of fraction digits. Must be between 0 and 100 — the range Number.prototype.toFixed accepts; outside it throws a RangeError. A fractional count truncates (2.7 → 2). A count that never arrived (NaN, null or...

maxDigits.description: Integer digits to reserve / hint (independent of fractionDigits). Bounded before use: a fractional count truncates (2.7 → 2), anything above 100 — including Infinity — caps at 100, and a negative count reserves...

hintedZeros.description: Render muted leading zeros filling the integer part to maxDigits. A negative value keeps them all — the sign is prepended and never consumes a zero (maxDigits 3: 12.3 → 012.3, -12.3 → -012.3) — so a negative reading...

hasSignSpacer.description: Reserve a minus-sign column ahead of the digits: an invisible sign placeholder holds the column open while the value is non-negative and the real sign fills it when negative, so the width does not change across zero....

spaceReserver.description: Explicit longest string to reserve width for (e.g. "0000.0"). Combined with the maxDigits-derived reserve by taking whichever is wider, so it can never reserve less than the formatted value needs.

off.description: Render offText instead of a number (e.g. equipment powered down).

offText.description: Text shown when off is true.

alignment.description: Text alignment of the number within its reserved width.

category.description: Semantic category of an advice block — picks the default marker icon and the active styling. Only meaningful for variant="advice". Available when variant==advice.

active.description: The advice is triggered: the marker swaps to its filled/status icon and the number takes the category's triggered styling (SemiBold for regular/optimal/eco, active text colour for the alert categories). Only...

touching.description: Setpoint focus (touch) state — only meaningful for role="setpoint".

hidePhase.description: Setpoint pop-up fade phase — only meaningful for role="setpoint".

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
